comparisons.peer_summary: Marketing, general and administrative expenses were $2.8 billion in 2024, an increase of $431 million or 18% from $2.4 billion in 2023, primarily due to increased go-to-market activities supporting revenue growth.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies report increases in General and Administrative expenses driven by workforce and operational scaling, but the specific drivers and magnitude differ significantly. AVGO attributes its massive 211% SG&A increase ($3,367 million) to headcount growth from the VMware Merger and higher equity award fair values. In contrast, AMD reports an 18% MG&A increase ($431 million) primarily due to go-to-market activities to support revenue growth, without citing a major merger or specific stock-based compensation value changes as the primary driver. While both face rising personnel-related costs, AVGO's change is one-time/structural via acquisition, whereas AMD's is organic growth-oriented.
